jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.snippet: Design and deploy intelligent AI agents at Optiver Sydney, owning the full lifecycle from prototyping to production, with a focus on impactful business outcomes.
jobs.description:
## About Optiver

Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam in 1986, with offices in Sydney, London, Chicago, Amsterdam, Hong Kong, and Singapore. The Sydney office is one of Optiver's primary locations for Asia-Pacific markets, trading a range of products across equities, options, and fixed income.

## About the Role

As an AI Engineer at Optiver Sydney, you will design and deploy intelligent AI agents that drive real business outcomes. You'll own the full lifecycle — from prototyping and experimentation through to production deployment — with a strong emphasis on impact measurement and iteration. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and quantitative problem-solving.

## Responsibilities

- Build and deploy AI agent systems in a high-performance trading environment
- Pair-programme on agentic workflows and develop AI solutions using modern LLM and orchestration frameworks
- Collaborate with quants, traders, and software engineers to identify and solve business problems
- Manage the full ML lifecycle: data exploration, model development, deployment, and monitoring
- Design scalable architectures for AI workflows and agentic pipelines

## Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
- Strong Python expertise with production software engineering skills
- Familiarity with LLM frameworks, agent orchestration (LangGraph, DSPy, etc.), and RAG pipelines
- Experience shipping production AI systems in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Interest in financial markets; prior finance knowledge is not required

## Tech Stack

Python, LLM frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph/DSPy), cloud ML platforms, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines

## Benefits

- Highly competitive remuneration
- Breakfast, lunch, and in-house barista at Sydney HQ
- Gym membership and chair massages
- Professional development and mentorship
- Collaborative, high-performance culture

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Engineer
jobs.snippet: Join a pivotal AI initiative at Optiver Sydney, driving ML infrastructure, training, and inference challenges to advance futures trading strategies.
jobs.description:
## About Optiver

Optiver is a technology-driven global market maker powering millions of trades a day. The ML Research team at Optiver advances the state of the art in applied machine learning for quantitative finance, working alongside world-class researchers and engineers.

## About the Role

Joining a pivotal AI initiative, the Machine Learning Research Engineer will drive ML infrastructure, training, and inference challenges that underpin Optiver's trading strategies. You'll work closely with quantitative researchers and traders on new ML experiments, capabilities, and data sources, and have the opportunity to blend your own development expertise with the best open-source frameworks and tools.

## Responsibilities

- Design and implement improvements to ML training and inference pipelines at massive scale
- Optimise researcher productivity through tooling and infrastructure improvements
- Collaborate on integrating deep learning models into live trading systems
- Contribute to internal ML frameworks and keep pace with the frontier of ML research
- Tackle core ML infrastructure, training, and inference challenges

## Requirements

- Strong publication record at top ML venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, or similar)
- Deep expertise in PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow internals
- Experience with large-scale distributed training and model optimisation
- Solid Python and C++ engineering skills
- PhD or equivalent research experience in Machine Learning or related field
- Interest in quantitative finance applications

## Tech Stack

PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow, CUDA, distributed training frameworks, Python, C++

## Benefits

- Highly competitive salary and profit-sharing
- Professional development budget and conference travel
- Flexible working arrangements
- Sydney CBD office with outstanding amenities

jobs.title: Graduate Machine Learning Modelling Engineer
jobs.snippet: Graduate ML engineering role at Optiver Sydney — apply ML to real quantitative trading problems, contributing to compute platforms and large-scale model training.
jobs.description:
## About Optiver

Optiver is a global electronic market maker where graduates take on real ownership and impact from day one. The Sydney office is a key hub for Asia-Pacific markets, housing world-class researchers, engineers, and traders.

## About the Role

As a Graduate ML Modelling Engineer, you will work alongside experienced researchers and engineers to build and iterate on ML models that inform Optiver's trading strategies. By the end of your first year, you'll have a clear and practical understanding of how ML techniques are applied in the quantitative trading industry.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain machine learning models for quantitative trading strategies
- Collaborate with quants on backtesting, model evaluation, and iteration
- Contribute to compute platforms supporting large-scale ML training workloads
- Apply modern ML techniques to real quantitative trading problems
- Build and enhance data pipelines for model development

## Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative field
- Strong foundation in Machine Learning fundamentals (optimisation, deep learning, statistics)
- Proficiency in Python; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow is a plus
- Graduating 2026 or early 2027 with Australian or New Zealand working rights
- Team player with genuine interest in quantitative finance (prior finance knowledge not required)

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, NumPy/pandas, distributed computing

## Benefits

- Highly competitive graduate remuneration package
- Structured mentorship and Optiver-provided training program
- Collaborative, intellectually stimulating team culture
- Catered daily meals and wellbeing benefits

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: ML Engineers at Xero design and develop infrastructure and services that power AI products reaching millions of small business customers globally.
jobs.description:
## About Xero

Xero is a global cloud-based accounting software platform connecting small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers. With millions of subscribers worldwide, Xero's AI Products group sits within the Data & Science function, bringing together ML Engineers and Applied Scientists to turn data into intelligent products.

## About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Xero Sydney, you will design and develop the infrastructure and services that power AI products reaching millions of customers every day. You'll work on recommendation systems, predictive analytics, automated insights, and intelligent automation features that help small businesses thrive.

## Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain scalable ML infrastructure and model serving systems
- Build and deploy models for cash flow prediction, anomaly detection, smart reconciliation, and customer intelligence
- Collaborate with Applied Scientists to productionise new models from research to production
- Monitor model performance and iterate rapidly in production
- Contribute to MLOps tooling and ML platform improvements

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in ML engineering or software engineering with an ML focus
- Strong Python skills with expertise in TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX
- Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML)
- Understanding of MLOps best practices, model monitoring, and CI/CD for ML
- Experience with data pipelines using Spark, Airflow, or dbt
- Experience writing software in Python, Scala, or Spark preferred

## Tech Stack

Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, AWS/GCP, Airflow, Spark, dbt, Kubernetes

## Benefits

- Flexible hybrid work arrangements (work where you perform best)
- Share options and competitive total compensation
- Learning and development budget
- Modern Sydney CBD office
- Health and wellbeing benefits

As a Data Engineer at Xero Melbourne, you'll engineer large and complex data sets and build robust, reusable, and optimised data pipelines. You'll develop data infrastructure supporting analytics, business intelligence, and machine learning models that power marketing decisions across Xero's global business.

jobs.title: Business Analyst – AI Specialist

jobs.description:

Jetstar Airways is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Qantas Group and Australia's leading low-cost carrier, flying to more than 60 destinations across Australia, New Zealand, Asia, and the Pacific. The Digital, IT and Analytics team builds AI and machine learning solutions that improve operational performance and customer experience.

## About the Role

As a Business Analyst – AI Specialist, you'll harness data, insights, and AI to enhance the experience for both crew and customers, driving operational efficiency across Jetstar's operations. You'll sit at the intersection of business strategy and technology delivery, translating complex business needs into actionable AI-powered solutions.

## Responsibilities

- Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements for AI and data initiatives
- Analyse operational data to identify AI-driven improvement opportunities across crew scheduling, operations, and customer experience
- Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions
- Build reports and dashboards for stakeholders at all levels
- Support development and implementation of Jetstar's AI strategy
- Facilitate workshops and UAT activities

## Requirements

- Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst in operational or technology environments
- Experience with AI strategy development or AI implementation projects is highly regarded
- Strong data analysis skills (SQL, Excel, Power BI, or Tableau)
- Experience building reports and dashboards
- Ability to present complex data-driven findings clearly to diverse stakeholders
- Airline, travel, or logistics industry experience is advantageous

## Benefits

- Travel benefits across Jetstar and Qantas Group flights
- Hybrid work model (Melbourne CBD base)
- Professional development support within the Qantas ecosystem
- Inclusive and diverse team culture

Afterpay (part of Block, Inc.) is Australia's leading buy-now-pay-later provider, enabling millions of consumers and merchants to transact across Australia, the US, UK, and beyond. The Machine Learning team builds models that keep the Afterpay platform safe, fair, and profitable.

## About the Role

As a Machine Learning Modeler, you will architect and build ML systems that power fraud prevention and abuse mitigation across Afterpay's lending lifecycle. You'll experiment with state-of-the-art algorithms, engineer features for risk models, and deploy systems that operate at massive transaction scale.

- Design and build machine learning models to detect fraudulent activity and assess lending risk in real-time

- Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), agents, and end-to-end ML workflow
- Strong Python skills with experience in model development and deployment

- Can work remotely from anywhere in Australia and New Zealand, or from Sydney or Melbourne offices

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Customer)
jobs.snippet: Apply state-of-the-art machine learning to solve complex marketing measurement problems at fast-growing Mutinex, the AI-powered marketing intelligence platform.
jobs.description:
## About Mutinex

Mutinex is an Australian-founded AI-powered marketing intelligence platform that helps major brands make smarter marketing investment decisions using machine learning and market mix modelling. Headquartered in South Melbourne with growing offices in Sydney and New York, Mutinex is expanding rapidly across Asia-Pacific and global markets. Data science is at the heart of Mutinex's product.

## About the Role

As a Customer Data Scientist, you'll apply state-of-the-art machine learning and scientific techniques to solve complex marketing measurement and attribution problems. You'll work directly with customer data to build models that help major brands understand the true ROI of their marketing spend across channels.

## Responsibilities

- Apply machine learning and Bayesian techniques to marketing mix modelling and multi-touch attribution
- Collaborate with customers to understand business problems and translate them into data science solutions
- Build and maintain scalable modelling pipelines for marketing analytics
- Communicate complex analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders in a compelling way
- Contribute to Mutinex's core modelling IP and research initiatives

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in data science, quantitative research, or analytical role
- Strong Python skills with familiarity in pandas, scikit-learn, and Bayesian modelling tools (PyMC, Stan)
- Understanding of causal inference, econometrics, or marketing analytics is highly valued
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience working with large transactional or marketing datasets

## Tech Stack

Python, pandas, scikit-learn, PyMC/Stan, SQL, dbt, cloud data platforms

## Benefits

- Startup environment with meaningful equity
- Hybrid work model (South Melbourne-based)
- Strong learning and growth culture with data-first mindset
- Collaborative, intellectually rigorous team

jobs.title: AI算法研究实习生（2026实习）
jobs.snippet: 明汯投资AI算法研究实习生，聚焦量化交易中的机器学习与深度学习研究，优秀实习生可转正。
jobs.description:
## 关于明汯投资

明汯投资是中国顶级量化私募之一，成立于2014年，管理规模超千亿元，专注于大数据与AI驱动的量化投资策略研究。在上海、北京、香港均设有办公室，团队汇聚国内外顶尖高校的技术与研究人才。

## 岗位职责

- 研究并实现先进的机器学习与深度学习算法，并将其应用于量化投资场景
- 参与量化因子挖掘、选股模型及策略开发
- 利用大数据技术处理海量金融市场数据，构建特征工程流水线
- 配合研究员完成模型回测、优化、验证及上线
- 跟踪学术前沿（NeurIPS、ICML等顶会成果）并探索在量化领域的应用

## 任职要求

- 在读本科/硕士/博士，计算机、数学、统计、物理、金融工程等STEM方向
- 扎实的机器学习基础，熟悉Python（numpy/pandas/scikit-learn/PyTorch）
- 具备良好的数学功底（线性代数、概率统计、优化理论）
- 热爱量化投资，对AI在金融领域的应用有浓厚兴趣
- 实习周期至少3个月，每周至少4天到岗（上海/北京均可）

## 薪资待遇

- 日薪300–500元（根据水平面议）
- 优秀实习生可获得转正机会
- 完善的导师制度与培训体系
- 定期团建与技术分享

jobs.title: AI算法研究员（2026校招）
jobs.snippet: 明汯投资2026届全职AI算法研究员，主攻大模型与机器学习在量化投资中的前沿应用，年薪极具竞争力。
jobs.description:
## 关于明汯投资

明汯投资是业内领先的量化私募基金，连续多年业绩名列前茅。技术团队由来自MIT、CMU、Caltech等顶尖高校的博士及研究人员组成，持续在AI、大数据、量化金融三个维度深耕。

## 岗位职责

- 独立研究前沿AI/ML算法并将其落地于量化投资实践
- 主导大模型、强化学习、图神经网络等新方法在金融场景中的探索与应用
- 构建高质量量化因子与预测模型，不断优化组合收益风险特征
- 与交易、研究团队深度协作，推进策略从研究到上线的全链路落地

## 任职要求

- 顶尖高校计算机、数学、统计、物理或金融工程专业本科及以上，2026届毕业
- 扎实的算法基础与机器学习理论知识
- 熟练掌握Python/C++编程
- 有顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR等）或量化研究项目经验者优先
- 对量化金融有浓厚兴趣与深度思考

## 薪资待遇

- 极具竞争力的全职年薪（面议）
- 年度绩效奖金
- 六险一金+补充医疗
- 上海/北京两地办公可选

jobs.title: AI算法研究员（梧桐计划）
jobs.snippet: 九坤投资梧桐计划，为量化业务全链路培养顶尖AI算法人才，年薪百万起，聚焦深度学习与大模型在量化交易中的创新应用。
jobs.description:
## 关于九坤投资

九坤投资（Ubiquant）成立于2012年，是中国规模最大的量化私募之一，旗下设有数据实验室、AI实验室（iQuestLab）和水滴实验室，在大数据驱动的策略研究方面处于行业领先地位。2026年初，九坤AI研究院发布了高效开源大模型iQuest-Coder-V1，展现出深厚的AI研发实力。

## 梧桐计划简介

梧桐计划是九坤面向顶尖应届毕业生的专项人才培养项目，涵盖AI算法研究、量化实现等核心方向，设有明确的成长通道和极具竞争力的薪资待遇（年薪百万量级），并同步开放向优秀候选人内推。

## 岗位职责

- 研究深度学习、强化学习等前沿AI技术并应用于量化策略开发
- 参与LLM、多模态、图神经网络等新方法在金融场景中的探索
- 与交易和研究团队深度合作，推动策略从实验室到生产的全链路落地
- 构建并优化高性能量化AI模型，提升策略超额收益

## 任职要求

- 顶尖高校（含海外知名高校）计算机、数学、统计、物理等专业本硕博
- 扎实的算法与机器学习理论基础
- 熟练Python/C++编程；具备ML框架（PyTorch等）使用经验
- 有竞赛获奖（ACM/ICPC、Kaggle Top等）或顶会论文者优先

jobs.title: 量化实现工程师（梧桐计划）
jobs.snippet: 九坤投资梧桐计划量化实现工程师，构建高性能量化交易与AI策略执行基础设施，面向热爱系统工程与量化金融的顶尖工程师。

jobs.title: 风险模型算法工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 微众银行2026暑期实习，招募风险模型算法工程师实习生，基于海量金融数据构建AI风控模型体系。
jobs.description:
## 关于微众银行

微众银行（WeBank）成立于2014年，是国内首家互联网银行，总部位于深圳，在区块链、人工智能、大数据和云计算等关键技术领域持续投入。微众银行已构建超过600个风控模型，并在联邦学习、可解释AI等前沿方向取得国际认可的技术成果（FATE联邦学习框架）。

## 岗位职责

- 参与贷前准入、贷中审核、贷后监测等全流程AI风控模型的开发与优化
- 基于海量金融行为数据进行特征工程，构建欺诈识别、信用评分等核心模型
- 利用机器学习及深度学习方法提升风控策略的精准度和覆盖率
- 配合研究员完成模型实验、A/B测试和上线验收

## 任职要求

- 统计学、计算机、数学、金融工程等相关专业在读本硕博，2027届及以后毕业
- 熟悉Python机器学习常用框架（scikit-learn、XGBoost、LightGBM、PyTorch等）
- 有金融数据分析或量化风控实习经历者优先
- 每周到岗至少4天，实习周期3个月以上

## 薪资待遇

- 日薪200–400元
- 优秀实习生可转为校招正式员工
- 深圳总部办公，餐补及交通补贴

jobs.description:
## 关于航天科工集团智能科技研究院

航天科工集团智能科技研究院有限公司（北京）是中国航天科工集团旗下专注于人工智能与智能系统研究的核心研究院，承担国防、航天、工业智能等领域的前沿AI技术攻关与工程化工作。

## 岗位职责

- 负责大语言模型（LLM）在国防及工业场景中的算法研究与系统设计
- 参与智能指挥系统、知识图谱、多模态感知等AI核心模块开发
- 开展LLM微调（SFT/RLHF）、领域适配与部署优化工作
- 与算法团队协同完成从原型到生产的全链路工程化

## 任职要求

- 人工智能、计算机科学与技术、电子科学与技术等相关专业硕士/博士，2026届
- 年龄要求：硕士不超过30岁，博士不超过35岁
- 熟练掌握Python/C++，具备深度学习框架（PyTorch等）实战经验
- 有NLP、大模型或智能系统工程项目经验者优先
- 北京市户籍可协助落户

## 投递方式

简历发送至：casichtznzhaopin@163.com
邮件命名格式：姓名+毕业院校+专业+硕士/博士+岗位编号

## 福利待遇

- 餐补、住房补贴、健康体检
- 带薪年假、节日福利
- 北京市正式编制（部分岗位）

jobs.description:
## 关于万得信息技术（Wind）

万得信息技术股份有限公司（Wind资讯）是中国领先的金融数据、信息和软件服务企业，Wind终端是国内金融机构的主流工具，覆盖超过95%的国内金融机构。万得正在将AI大模型深度融入其金融数据产品生态，构建下一代智能投研基础设施。

## 岗位职责

- 负责面向金融场景的LLM微调、RAG系统设计与优化
- 构建金融知识图谱与智能问答系统，赋能Wind终端AI化升级
- 开发面向量化研究的AI Agent，实现海量金融数据的自动化检索与分析
- 参与金融垂类大模型（FinLLM）的预训练、后训练及评估体系建设

## 任职要求

- 计算机、数学、统计等相关专业本科及以上，知名院校背景
- 熟悉LLM微调（SFT/RLHF）、RAG、Agent等主流技术栈
- 具备Python及主流深度学习框架（PyTorch/HuggingFace）实战经验
- 有金融数据处理、量化研究或自然语言处理项目经历者优先
- 本次招聘截止日期为2026年6月（春招），建议尽早投递

## 工作地点

上海（含北京部分岗位）

jobs.title: 算法工程师（AI for Science / 大模型方向）
jobs.snippet: 晶泰科技AI算法工程师，用大模型与深度学习驱动药物与材料科学研发，在AI for Science前沿领域实现商业化突破。
jobs.description:
## 关于晶泰科技（XtalPi）

晶泰科技（XtalPi）由三位MIT物理学家于2015年创立，是以量子物理为根基、人工智能为引擎、机器人为执行载体的新型科研平台，专注于AI驱动的药物研发与先进材料科学。总部在深圳，上海研发中心位于张江综合创新园，研究人员占员工总数超70%。晶泰科技是

赛道的代表性企业，已完成多轮融资，投资方包括腾讯、Google等。

## 岗位职责

- 开发并应用深度学习模型（Transformer、图神经网络、扩散模型等）解决药物分子设计问题
- 参与大模型（LLM）在化学、生物学垂直领域的微调与应用开发
- 构建端到端的AI实验自动化管线，实现科研工作流的智能化
- 与实验科学家、计算化学团队协作，迭代优化模型性能

## 任职要求

- 计算机、AI/ML、应用数学、计算化学或相关STEM专业本科及以上
- 掌握Python及主流深度学习框架（PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow）
- 有图神经网络（GNN）、分子生成、蛋白质结构预测等方向经验者优先
- 具备良好的科研能力和代码工程素养
- 2026届及以后毕业，或有丰富相关工作经验

## 工作地点

上海（张江）、深圳、北京（多地同步招聘）
